A letter to Aryan

Most people in admissions look at a non-traditional path and see a problem to manage. I see the opposite. I started TransferringUP because I lived it: a 1.25 GPA my freshman year of high school, ranked 399 of 411, written off by schools with 87% acceptance rates. What eventually got me into Cornell was not pretending none of that happened, it was learning how to frame it.

Your background is not something we will apologize for or bury on the second page. Handled right, it becomes the spine of your application, the reason an admissions officer remembers your file instead of the forty others they read that night.

What follows is exactly how we would do that for you: how we find your real story, how we frame it so it reads as strength, and everything we handle so you are never doing this alone. Read it, then let us talk.

How we will approach your application

We make your story the strategy.

Admissions officers spend only a few minutes on each file, and a non-traditional application gets flagged in the first thirty seconds. The question in their head is simple: what happened here? Everything we do is built so the answer is a story about momentum and direction, never a list of things to explain away.

01
We find the real story.
Before a single essay, we dig into the why behind your path, the decisions, the turning point, what you actually took from it. Most students bury this. For a non-traditional applicant it is usually the most compelling thing on the page.
02
We frame it as strength.
An unconventional route is not a weakness to defend, it is context that makes your trajectory undeniable. We position your background as the setup, not the apology, so the reader sees growth, drive, and someone who will thrive on their campus.
03
We make every piece point the same way.
Your essays, your activities, your recommendations, your major and your school list all reinforce one sharp narrative. When an application is that coherent, admissions stops reading a transcript and starts rooting for a person.
“
Your background isn’t a liability to explain away. It’s the most interesting thing about your file.

What working with us is like

A genuinely personal service.

1
Hyper-personalized
One student at a time.
We take a limited number of students so every plan is built from scratch around you, your major, your GPA, your story, and the exact schools you want. There is no template, no recycled essay, no generic tier list. We study your situation and build the strategy that actually fits it.
2
Unlimited access
We're one text away.
You get a direct line to us, 24/7, for your entire cycle. Text us anytime: a question at 11pm, a panic the night before a deadline, "should I add this school," "is this paragraph working." Plus weekly one-on-one calls. No ticket queue, no waiting days for a reply, you reach a real person who already knows your application.
3
Profile building
We build it with you, not just edit it.
Most consultants polish what you already have. We help you create what you are missing. We guide you in building high-impact extracurriculars from the ground up, passion projects, nonprofits, research, leadership, then position them so admissions sees real impact. This is often the difference between a maybe and a yes.
